page.overview:
Who is Usunoro?

Usunoro is a Shinuchi of the Beasts Pirates and part of the Armored Division led by Sasaki.

Usunoro is a muscular man with tanned skin and long blond hair, beard and mustache. Due to his SMILE ability, his lower body is a giant tortoise with light green skin and a dark green shell. He wears metal braces around his elbows, shoulder pads, a black cape, and a metal helmet. His belt is also covered by a wide fur-lined sash, and he wears white gloves.

In his first appearance, he had a helmet with long horns, not the one seen on him later.

Usunoro is quick to take the initiative as he attacked Momonosuke first out of all the Armored Division members, but does not pay enough attention to his surroundings, failing to notice Yamato before it was too late. He appears to be quite cruel and has no problem attacking a child with the intent of killing him.
